description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to strengthen the prevention, detection and response to the COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt.

To prevent, detect and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19 and strengthen national systems for public health preparedness.The PDO will be monitored through the following PDO level outcome indicators:• Percentage of MOHP hospitals with PPE and infection control products and supplies, without stock-outs of more than two types of items in the preceding two weeks. • Number of contextualized messages conducted for COVID-19 prevention.• Number of contacts of confirmed COVID-19 cases who were traced as per the national contact tracing protocol outlined in the National Comprehensive COVID-19 Response Plan.• Number of dedicated quarantines, isolation & treatment facilities for COVID-19.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section 1, B, 1, (a): The Borrower, through MOHP shall, not later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, or suchlater date as agreed by the Bank, prepare and adopt a Project Operations Manual containing detailed guidelines and procedures forthe implementation of the Project.

Schedule 2, Section 1, C, 1: Not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, or such later date as agreed by the Bank,appoint and thereafter maintain, at all times during the implementation of the Project, an independent verification agent withqualifications and experience and under terms of reference acceptable to the Bank (“Verification Agent”).

Schedule 2, Section 1, F, 2: The Borrower shall through MOHP, ensure that the Project is implemented in accordance with theEnvironmental and Social Commitment Plan (“ESCP”), in a manner acceptable to the Bank.
